neighbours.label: a step inside a technical description of how a food or material is produced (fermented in steel, the liquid product of curdling, aged before bottling), as opposed to the same product described as something bought, eaten or used
fire: The grapes are crushed, then fermented in stainless steel tanks for two weeks.
Butter is made by churning cream until the fat separates from the buttermilk.
After pressing, the cider is aged in oak casks before it is bottled.
The milk is heated, curdled with rennet, and the whey is drained off.
Raw cocoa beans are fermented, dried, roasted and then ground into paste.
The pulp is bleached, pressed into sheets and dried on heated rollers.
Olives are washed, crushed into a paste and then spun to extract the oil.
Malted barley is mashed in hot water and the sugary wort is boiled with hops.
quiet: The grapes we bought at the market were sweet and cheap this week.
Butter tastes wonderful on warm toast with a little honey.
After dinner, we shared a bottle of cider on the porch.
The milk in our fridge went sour while we were away.
My niece loves cocoa with marshmallows on cold mornings.
The paper in this notebook is thick and smooth to write on.
Olives and cheese were served before the main course.
My uncle drinks one beer with his dinner on Fridays.
